comments.note: Python 3 was not available on this machine, so the fixture was generated using a two-step process: (1) System.Formats.Tar.TarWriter in a temporary C# console app to produce the raw device.tar with a PAX-format BlockDevice entry (dev/null, major=1, minor=3); (2) 7-Zip (7z.exe) to XZ-compress device.tar to device.tar.xz. The existing glob in the .csproj (<None Include="Fixtures/archives/*.tar.xz") automatically picks up the new file. The fixture is 212 bytes. Future maintainers can also use the Python script documented in TarXzArchiveExtractorTests.cs.
